The native menu item's classroom availability stays unproven (pulsarListAvailability, G9) and no native window/event parity is claimed (G5). No acquisition, beam, noise, timing, measurement, notebook, PLR/DAT/CSV, receiver-formula or investigation-format change. Does not complete Radio I06/I07/N07/E06 or any inventory capability and claims no scientific or original-runtime equivalence.

webPolicies.W1: Distinct native-caption command governed by the latest visible/enabled history; hidden (also hidden with Enabled set) has no command, shown-disabled is disabled; the current Access option, catalog readiness and receiver presence are not folded into the flags; the reference Open stays read-only.
webPolicies.W2: Handler-time gates on the latest refs before any write (WEB-PP-LIST-04 order); an invalid receiver seed, a switched-off device or Tracking off alone are not gates.
webPolicies.W3: One synchronous preparation on one snapshot; seed from the post-write buffer; both owners re-checked before the first commit; all-or-nothing is web policy, not native rollback.
webPolicies.W4: The existing web activation runs once, creating or reusing the window (Find memory kept; JD, density and edits reset); native Show/OnActivate/lifetime unproven.
webPolicies.W5: No Receiver Open, onReceiverOpened, source refresh, paint, Record control or reseed; menu flags unchanged; no picker-cursor notification (the activation's scan is the final cursor); no new selector.
webPolicies.W6: At the click only the shared buffer changes; later existing coupling, refresh, clock association and Receive header may observe it; no future-signal invariant.
webPolicies.W7: Button and keyboard with held-key protection; focus on the Parameters heading; repeat reuses the window. No Win32 window-state or activation parity.
webPolicies.W8: Session only: no storage, export, settings, writer, PLR or audio change; plain UI text, addresses only in provenance.
